coaches.title: AI Coaches
coaches.intro: Five scripted coaches help you explore routes, learn, write an honest CV, test a business idea and shape freelance work. Every answer comes from a prepared script linked to your profile and the course library.
coaches.notFound: This coach is not part of the demonstration.
coaches.greeting: Hello {{name}}, I am {{coach}}. Choose a question below or type your own. I answer from a prepared script, so if I do not recognise a question I will suggest sample questions or a human mentor.
coaches.inputLabel: Type a question for the coach
coaches.scriptedNote: Scripted demonstration. The coach does not create new answers and does not predict hiring decisions.
coaches.humanHelp: Prefer to talk to a person?
coaches.sampleClient: Sample client brief: Demo Local Retailer
coaches.practiceQuestion: Tell me about a time you helped a customer with a problem.

draft.title: Draft for your {{target}}
draft.empty: Add some text before saving this draft.
draft.review: I have reviewed this draft. It is accurate and describes only what I actually did. AI drafts can contain mistakes.
draft.savedToast: Draft saved to your {{target}}. You can keep editing it in the toolkit.

rules.title: How these coaches work
rules.scripted: Answers follow prepared scripts. Unrecognised questions get sample questions or a human mentor, never invented answers.
rules.grounded: Suggestions point to your profile, your route and courses already in the library.
rules.review: Drafts are starting points. Review and edit them before you use them anywhere.

mentorCard.title: Want human support?
mentorCard.body: Book a 30 minute session with a sample mentor using points or your programme allocation.

cohort.title: My Cohort and Sessions
cohort.intro: Only the training activities assigned to your cohort appear here. Enrolling in a general course never unlocks restricted sessions.
cohort.attendanceLater: Recorded by your trainer after the session

room.note: Demo room: video tiles are illustrations. No live meeting is created and nothing leaves the prototype.

none.title: You are not assigned to a training cohort yet
none.body: You are not assigned to a training cohort yet. Explore self-paced courses while you wait. Your trainer will add your sessions here once you join a cohort.

noSessions.title: No sessions scheduled yet
noSessions.body: Your trainer has not added sessions to this cohort yet. Check back soon.

cohort.sessionsBody: Sample schedule for November 2026. All times are Syria time.
cohort.calendarHint: Select a session in the calendar to see its details.

restricted.title: {{count}} restricted sessions from other cohorts ({{cohorts}}) are not listed
restricted.body: Cohort sessions are only visible to their members. A learner outside a cohort cannot see or join its sessions.

event.registeredToast: You are registered for Meet employers and clients
event.registeredNote: Demo registration only. No invitation is sent.
event.openToAll: Open to all demo learners. No invitation leaves the prototype.

community.title: Community and Events
community.intro: Moderated groups where you can ask questions, practise and share ideas with other learners and trainers. All posts are sample content.
community.cohortGroupBody: Private to members of your cohort and its trainer.
community.restricted: Cohort groups for {{cohorts}} are restricted to their members and are not shown.
community.newPostPlaceholder: Ask a question or share a tip
community.postHint: Be kind and constructive. Do not share personal, health or contact details.
community.postError: Write at least a few words before posting.
community.reportToast: Thank you. The post has been reported.
community.reportToastBody: A moderator will review it. Reports are confidential.
community.reported: You reported this post. It is hidden while a moderator reviews it.

empty.title: No posts in this group yet
empty.body: Start the conversation: ask a question or share something you learned this week.

rules.title: Community guidelines
rules.moderated: Every group is moderated by trained staff. Report anything unkind or unsafe.
rules.privacy: Personal support, disability and assessment information is never shown in the community.
rules.noRanking: There is no public leaderboard or competitive ranking. Progress is personal.

mentors.title: Mentorship
mentors.intro: Book a 30 minute session with a sample mentor. Use your points or, when your programme includes it, your programme allocation.
mentors.rules: Points are deducted once on a successful booking and returned if you cancel before the session. Essential learning and applications never require points.

noSessions.title: No mentor sessions yet
noSessions.body: Choose a mentor above, pick the sample slot and tell them your goal. Your booking will appear here.

mentors.notFound: This mentor is not part of the demonstration.
mentors.privacy: Mentors see your goal and question only. They never see disability or support information, assessment answers or other unrelated records.

booking.completedToast: Session marked as completed. Your mentor's feedback is ready.
booking.cancelBodyPoints: The slot becomes free again and {{count}} points return to your balance once.
booking.cancelBodyAllocation: The slot becomes free again and your programme allocation can be used for another session.
booking.cancelledRefund: Booking cancelled. {{count}} points returned to your balance.

feedback.title: Mentor feedback
feedback.thanks: Thank you. Your rating is saved.
feedback.rated: You rated this session {{count}} out of 5.
feedback.notRated: Your rating helps the programme improve mentoring.

locked.title: Not enough points yet
locked.body: Your balance is {{balance}} points. A session costs {{cost}} points, so you need {{missing}} more. These activities earn points:
locked.essential: Essential learning and applying for opportunities never require points.

form.title: Book a session with {{name}}
form.intro: Four short steps. No invitations or notifications leave the prototype.
form.slotTakenHelp: This slot is already booked. Choose another mentor or check again later.
form.errSlot: Select the sample slot to continue.
form.goalPlaceholder: For example: prepare for a customer-service interview
form.errGoal: Describe your goal in a few words.
form.question: Question for the mentor
form.questionPlaceholder: What would you like to ask?
form.errQuestion: Add one question for the mentor.
form.step3: How would you like to book?
form.allocationYes: Your cohort trainer offers this session as part of your programme. No points are used.
form.allocationNo: Available when this mentor is also a trainer in your cohort.
form.alreadyBooked: You already have a booked session with this mentor. See My mentor sessions.
form.summaryPoints: {{count}} points will be deducted once. Cancel before the session to get them back.
form.summaryAllocation: This session uses your programme allocation. No points are deducted.
form.noInvites: Demo booking: no email, invitation or calendar event is sent.
form.confirmedBody: {{when}}, Syria time. You can cancel or simulate the completed session from My mentor sessions.
form.pointsShort: Balance {{balance}}. You need more points for this option.

opps.title: Opportunity hub
opps.body: Sample jobs, internships, freelance projects and enterprise support. Each card explains how your learning and toolkit match, and what is still missing.

tabHint.jobs: Salaried roles and internships with fictional employers. Filter by type, location and work format.
tabHint.flex: Part-time roles and short client projects. Filter by type, remote or in person, and how soon the deadline is.
tabHint.enterprise: Mentoring and customer-validation support for early business ideas. No funding is offered.

empty.title: No opportunities match these filters
empty.body: Clear the filters or try another tab. New sample opportunities appear here when employers publish them.

opps.closedNote: Opportunity closed: applications are no longer accepted

match.title: Why this may suit you
match.route: Fits the career route you chose
match.skill: Your skill or interest "{{mine}}" relates to {{skill}}

toolkit.cv: Your CV is saved in the career toolkit
toolkit.proposal: You have a saved proposal draft

gapToolkit.cv: Build your CV in the toolkit
gapToolkit.proposal: Draft a proposal in the proposal builder

match.none: No matching evidence yet. The gaps show where to start.
match.noGaps: No gaps found in the listed requirements.
match.disclaimer: Based on your demo profile and sample opportunity data; not live labour-market evidence. Matches explain your evidence and never predict a hiring decision.

detail.notFoundBody: This opportunity is not part of the demonstration. Browse the hub to find open sample opportunities.

note.freelance: Being selected for a project is not the same as completing the work. Both are tracked separately.
note.enterprise: This is mentoring and customer-validation support. No cash funding is promised.

apply.title: Your application

intro.job: Attach your CV, show your course evidence and add a short motivation answer.
intro.internship: Attach your CV, confirm your availability and show your course evidence.
intro.partTime: Attach your CV, confirm your availability and add a work sample.
intro.freelance: Share your service profile, a portfolio sample and a proposal.
intro.enterprise: Attach your business concept and explain your motivation.

apply.closedBody: Keep building your evidence. Similar sample opportunities may open later in the hub.
apply.attachCv: Attach my CV from the toolkit
apply.attachBusiness: Attach my business concept from the toolkit
apply.noCv: You have not saved a CV yet.
apply.noBusiness: You have not saved a business concept yet.
apply.noServiceProfile: You have not saved a service profile yet.
apply.proposalReview: Review the proposal in your toolkit before you submit. AI drafts must be checked by you.

coursesRule.all: Course evidence: all of these courses
coursesRule.any: Course evidence: at least one of these courses

apply.uploadNote: Simulated upload: a sample filename is attached and no file leaves the prototype. Never upload real personal documents.
apply.motivationPlaceholder: Why does this opportunity interest you, and what have you done that is relevant?
apply.motivationHint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} characters. Be honest and specific.
apply.fixFirst: Complete the missing items before you submit ({{count}}).
apply.reviewNote: Check every document before you submit. The organisation sees only the evidence you attach, never your assessment answers or support information.
apply.submittedBody: It now shows as Submitted in your timeline and in the organisation's view.

apps.title: My applications
apps.body: Follow each application from draft to outcome. Status changes recorded by employers, clients and support hosts appear here.

empty.title: No applications yet
empty.body: Open the opportunity hub, check the match explanation and save your first draft.

apps.noActive: No applications in progress. Explore the hub for your next step.

employment.draft: Complete the required evidence and submit before the deadline.
employment.submitted: Wait for the employer review. Practise interview answers meanwhile.
employment.underReview: The employer is reviewing your evidence. Prepare with interview practice.
employment.shortlisted: You are shortlisted. Prepare for an interview with Lina AI or a mentor.
employment.interview: Prepare examples for the interview and check the time with the employer.
employment.offer: Review the offer. A start is confirmed only when the employer records it.
employment.hired: Your start is confirmed. Follow-up check-ins will ask how the role is going.
employment.notSelected: Read the feedback, try the recommended learning and keep applying.
employment.withdrawn: You withdrew this application. Explore other opportunities when you are ready.

freelance.draft: Attach your service profile, portfolio sample and proposal, then submit.
freelance.submitted: Wait for the client to review your proposal.
freelance.clientDiscussion: Agree scope, timing and the review round with the client.
freelance.selected: You are selected. Start delivery as agreed and record progress.
freelance.inDelivery: Deliver the work and handle the agreed review round.
freelance.completed: Work completed. Add the sample to your portfolio with the client's permission.
freelance.notSelected: Read the feedback, refine your proposal and try another project.
freelance.withdrawn: You withdrew this proposal. Explore other projects when you are ready.

enterprise.draft: Attach your business concept and motivation, then submit.
enterprise.submitted: Wait for the support host to review your concept.
enterprise.review: The host is reviewing your concept. Keep testing with customers.
enterprise.accepted: You are accepted to the clinic. Prepare your next customer experiment.
enterprise.participating: Attend clinic sessions and record what you learn.
enterprise.completed: Clinic completed. Update your business concept with the evidence you gathered.
enterprise.notSelected: Read the feedback, strengthen your customer evidence and try again later.
enterprise.withdrawn: You withdrew this application. Keep developing your concept.

detail.oppClosed: This opportunity is now closed. Your application and its outcome are kept.
detail.noFeedback: No feedback yet. Feedback from the organisation appears here.
detail.notFoundBody: This application does not belong to your profile. Open your applications list to continue.

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.jobBody: A start appears here once the employer records it. An outcome you report yourself is shown separately as pending confirmation.
outcomes.offerNote: An offer is not yet a confirmed start. It counts as a placement only after the employer confirms your start.

freelance.completedBody: The client confirmed the agreed deliverables.
freelance.explain: Being selected is not the same as completing the work, so both are tracked. Payment is agreed between you and the client and is not tracked in this demo.

enterprise.body: A milestone in your enterprise journey.
enterprise.explain: Acceptance means mentoring and customer-validation support. It is not funding and is not counted as an employment placement.

outcomes.reportToast: Thank you. Your outcome is saved as pending confirmation.
outcomes.reportHint: Something happened outside the platform? Report it here. It stays pending until the organisation confirms it.

notSelected.title: Not selected this time, and that is part of the journey
notSelected.reassurance: Your learning, points, toolkit and mentor access all stay with you. Use the feedback to make your next application stronger.
notSelected.defaultFeedback: Thank you for applying. Your answers were polite and clear. To strengthen your next application, add one specific example from your training and complete the recommended course.
notSelected.learnBody: This course builds the evidence this kind of opportunity asks for.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this application?
withdraw.body: The organisation will see that you withdrew. Your learning, toolkit and points are not affected.

toolkit.title: Build your career evidence
toolkit.body: Your CV, interview practice, business concept, freelance profile and proposals in one place. Tools for your route come first, and every tool stays open to you.
toolkit.coachNote: Drafts you save from the AI coaches appear here. They stay editable: review every draft before you use it.

cv.intro: Write what you actually did. Save your changes, preview the CV and print or save a sample copy.
cv.contactHint: Contact details come from your profile.
cv.summaryHint: Two or three sentences about who you are and the work you are looking for.
cv.noBullets: No experience bullets yet. Add one, or improve one with Lina AI.
cv.bulletPlaceholder: Start with an action, for example: Organised...
cv.honestHint: Add numbers only if you can verify them.
cv.suggestedBody: Suggested from your learning record. Review each one and tick only the courses you want on your CV.
cv.suggestedEmpty: Complete a course and it will be suggested here.
cv.previewBody: This is how your CV looks with your current changes. Print it or save it as a PDF from the print window.
cv.sampleFooter: Sample CV created in a demonstration platform.

interview.intro: Choose an opportunity and a question, type your answer and get feedback on relevance, clarity and evidence.
interview.question: Question
interview.answerHint: Try: the situation, what you did and the result.
interview.tooShort: Write at least one full sentence before asking for feedback.
interview.disclaimer: This is practice feedback from a simple demo check. It is not a score and not a prediction of any hiring decision.
interview.historyEmptyBody: Answer a question and save the feedback to build your history.

relevance.developing: Link your answer to the question and the role.
relevance.clear: Your answer is on topic. Name one skill the role asks for.
relevance.strong: Your answer fits the question and the role well.

clarity.developing: Add more detail in two or three full sentences.
clarity.clear: Easy to follow. Finish with the result.
clarity.strong: Well structured, with a clear result at the end.

evidence.developing: Describe what you did yourself, step by step.
evidence.clear: You named actions. Add what changed because of them.
evidence.strong: Specific actions and a result you can stand behind.

next.relevance: Answer the same question again and connect it to one skill in the opportunity.
next.clarity: Answer again using situation, action and result, and finish with one sentence about the result.
next.evidence: Answer again with two specific things you did yourself. Use the STAR worksheet to plan it.

business.intro: Describe your idea and what you have learned from customers. Save a draft and generate a pitch outline you can edit.

hints.problem: What happens today, in their words?
hints.evidence: What did customers actually tell you?
hints.model: How could the idea sustain itself?
hints.costs: Main costs to start and to run.
hints.nextExperiment: One small test you can run soon.

business.required: Add at least the customer and the problem before saving.
business.noQuestions: No questions yet. Draft some with Amal AI or add your own.
business.questionPlaceholder: Ask about what they do today
business.questionsHint: Open questions about past behaviour give more honest answers than questions about your idea.
business.outlineEmpty: Generate a pitch outline to turn your fields into a two-minute pitch structure.
business.outlineHint: Edit freely. Generate again after you update the fields.

pitch.ask: Support I am looking for: mentoring and feedback

business.noFunding: Support programmes set their own criteria. This outline does not imply acceptance or funding.
business.copyFailed: Copying is not available here. Select the text instead.

freelance.intro: Describe the service you offer and preview what a client sees.

hints.services: One clear service linked to a skill you have.
hints.samples: Label sample work as sample work.
hints.assignments: The kind of project you want.

freelance.required: Describe at least one service before saving.
freelance.previewHint: See your profile the way a client would.
freelance.privacy: Clients never see your contact details, assessment answers or support information.

proposal.intro: Scope a proposal for a client brief, save it and attach it to a freelance application.
proposal.emptyBody: Start a new proposal, or ask Ziad AI to draft one from a sample client brief.
proposal.noApps: You have no freelance applications yet.
proposal.noDrafts: Proposals can be attached to draft applications only.
proposal.reviewFirst: Review the proposal before you submit the application.

profile.title: Your profile and privacy
profile.body: Keep your details up to date and decide what employers can see.

sections.accountIntro: Email or mobile is enough. No messages are sent in this demo.
sections.supportIntro: Optional. These help arrange access to learning and sessions. They never affect recommendations or rankings.

fields.name: Full name
fields.consentProgramme: I agree to take part in the programme
fields.consentEmployerVisible: Show my career profile to employers and clients

hints.contact: Add an email or a mobile number.
hints.password: Password changes are not part of this demonstration.
hints.age: Demo profiles are adults aged 18 to 24. Production age eligibility is still to be confirmed.
hints.chips: Type and press Enter, or separate with commas.
hints.support: Use general wording. Do not add medical details.
hints.consentProgramme: Your trainer and centre use your record to deliver training and support.
hints.upload: Simulated upload. Never upload a real personal document in this demo.

profile.supportPrivate: Support and disability information is never visible to employers, clients or mentors.
profile.visibleOn: On: employers and clients can find your career evidence in candidate search.
profile.visibleOff: Off: employers only see what you send with an application.

errors.contact: Add an email or a mobile number.

who.title: Who sees what
who.body: You stay in control. This is what each group can see in the platform.

employers.title: Employers and clients
employers.sees: Your name, skills, completed courses, CV and portfolio, as career evidence you approve.
employers.off: Hidden from candidate search. They only see what you send with an application.
employers.never: Never: assessment answers, support or disability information, coaching notes.

trainers.title: Your trainer and centre team
trainers.sees: Your programme record: profile, learning progress, attendance and support preferences you share, for access arrangements only.
trainers.never: Never: other centres' staff, or your private coach conversations.

mentors.title: Mentors
mentors.sees: The goal and question you add when you book a session.
mentors.never: Never: disability or support information, or unrelated records.

reports.title: UNICEF and partner reports
reports.sees: Totals across many learners, such as course completions and outcomes.
reports.never: Never: your individual support needs in aggregate reports.
